mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, actor_type, actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, ip, user_agent, details, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, CAST(#{ip} AS inet), #{userAgent}, CAST(#{details} AS jsonb), #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT action FROM audit_logs ORDER BY action
